## GET /v1/crew/owner/bundles

List capability bundles that came from apps.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Owner |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. |

## PATCH /v1/crew/owner/bundles/{bundle_id}

Change a capability bundle's settings.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Owner |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. |

Changed by the user: each tool's approval and enabled, and the plan approval switch. Setting a write tool to never needs confirm_write_never=true (the panel asks for confirmation first), else 400 invalid_request; each such change writes an audit record. These settings survive a manifest update.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bundle_id` | string | yes | bnd_ id |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Request body fields (`application/json`), [UpdateBundleRequest](schemas.md#updatebundlerequest):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plan_approval` | boolean | no | Plan approval switch (on by default); when off, each write call asks separately. |
| `confirm_write_never` | boolean | no | Must be true when any tool whose access is write is set to never. |
| `tools` | object | no | Keyed by tool name. |

## DELETE /v1/crew/owner/bundles/{bundle_id}

Remove a capability bundle from this crew.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Owner |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. |

Disconnects the app from this crew: revokes every grant that references this bundle (the app's backend connection and the embed connection), through the same revocation as DELETE /v1/crew/owner/grants/{grant_id}; then deletes the template, mounts, skills and site tokens, and revokes the tokens at the site when the site's metadata has a revocation_endpoint (RFC 7009). A running conversation that calls these tools afterwards gets the tool error tools_removed from the proxy (ToolError in components.yaml).

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bundle_id` | string | yes | bnd_ id |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bot` | `keep`, `remove` | no | Required only when kind is bot: keep leaves the Bot in place (the app's tools and skills are taken off and its private memory stays), remove takes it away too (its private memory is archived like a closed Bot's). When kind is bot and this is absent, 400 invalid_request. |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [Deleted](schemas.md#deleted):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `object` | string | no |  |
| `deleted` | `true` | yes |  |

Errors. The response body is [Error](schemas.md#error); its `error.code` field holds the code.
